name: @jinwon-int/pr-shepherd
description: Conservative PR shepherd CLI for monitoring and repairing OpenClaw upstream PR drift.

scripts.check: node --check pr-shepherd.mjs && for f in lib/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && node --check examples/sandbox-repair-proof.mjs && node --check examples/field-deploy/doctor.mjs
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm run docs:policy:check && npm test
